{{Quote|Echo Station 3-T-8. We have spotted Imperial walkers.|Sergeant major Trey Callum|<ref name="ESB" />}}
'''Trey Callum''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[sergeant major]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Battle of Hoth]]. He was formerly an [[Imperial officer]] who decided to join the Alliance, and served at [[Echo Base]] on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]] in [[3 ABY]]. When the [[Galactic Empire]] [[Battle of Hoth|invaded]] Hoth, Callum, in charge of [[Outpost Beta]], reported the presence of Imperial [[All Terrain Armored Transport]]s.

As the Imperial [[Imperial Army|forces]] engaged the rebel defenders, Callum ordered his [[soldier]]s to focus fire on the [[walker]]s. When Imperial [[Cold weather assault trooper|snowtroopers]] joined the fight, the [[sergeant]] major ordered his men to hold the line, and the [[Stormtrooper|snowtrooper]] force was decimated before the rebels began to retreat.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Word from our scouts is we've got stormtroopers approaching our position. We cannot let them get inside the base. You understand me? The enemy will not pass this trench.|Trey Callum, to his soldiers|<ref name="Beyond Hope">{{StoryCite|story=Beyond Hope|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back}}</ref>}}
Trey Callum was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as an [[Imperial officer]] in the [[Galactic Empire]] before choosing to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in opposing them.<ref name="FC" /> By [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], which includes Trey Callum's appearance, to [[3 ABY]].</ref> Callum was an [[Alliance officer|officer]] in the [[Alliance Military]] and was stationed at [[Echo Base]] on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]]. There, he commanded the [[Rebel trooper|soldiers]] of [[Outpost Beta]], a series of artillery trenches dug between Hoth's [[Nev Ice Flow]] and [[South Ridge]].<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

[[File:Callum.png|thumb|left|250px|Trey Callum communicating with command]]
When the Empire [[Project Swarm|discovered]] and [[Battle of Hoth|attacked]] Echo Base, they were forced to deploy [[Imperial Army|ground forces]] due to the base's [[Deflector shield|shield]]. This deployment included [[Blizzard Force]], a group of [[All Terrain Armored Transport]]s directed to destroy the [[deflector shield generator]] at Echo Base.<ref name="Complete Locations" /> As his men prepared their defenses, Callum spotted the [[walker]]s with a pair of [[macrobinoculars]] from [[Echo Station 3-T-8]] and reported the vehicles' approach back to Echo Base.<ref name="ESB" /> During the ensuing battle, Callum ordered his [[trooper]]s at Outpost Beta to focus fire on the enemy walkers, which took no penetrating damage to their [[armor]]. He later ordered the soldiers [[Emon Kref]] and [[Andry Ked]] to take cover.<ref name="Beyond Hope" />

The soldiers cheered after the first [[Blizzard 2|AT-AT]] was destroyed. By that time, Callum received word from scouts that [[Cold weather assault trooper|snowtroopers]] were approaching his position. The sergeant major marched along the trenches as the cheering died down, informing the other rebels of the incoming Imperial troops and ordering that the defenses keep the Imperial forces from passing the trenches.<ref name="Beyond Hope" /> Callum's troops were able to decimate the [[Stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] of Blizzard Force using anti-personnel batteries,<ref name="Complete Locations" /> but were soon forced into a full retreat.<ref name="Beyond Hope" /> Ultimately, the Empire successfully destroyed the shield generator and claimed victory on Hoth, but not before the Alliance managed to evacuate large amounts of its personnel.<ref name="Complete Locations" /> Outpost Beta was the first defense post reported to be destroyed.<ref name="BTC">''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]''</ref>

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Focus fire on those walkers! Keep them back!|Trey Callum gives orders|<ref name="Beyond Hope" />}}
While on Hoth, Callum wore rebel snow [[Alliance military uniform|gear]] including a white [[Thermal flak jacket/Canon|thermal flak jacket]], white [[command gauntlet]]s, and a white [[insulated watch cap]] with a [[Comlink|comm set]], a white face wrap, white [[Hat|cap]] warmers, and [[anti-glare goggles]].<ref name="ESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trey Callum was created for the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']],<ref name="ESB" /> in which he was portrayed by an uncredited [[Bob Anderson]].<ref name="Bob Anderson autograph 1">{{WebCite|url=http://www.let-the-wookie-win.com/index.php?showimage=344|text=My Bob Anderson Starwars Autograph|author=Oldbury, Dave Louis|date=2011-06-21|work=Star Wars Autograph Collecting|nobackup=1}}</ref> Anderson was a stuntman who also acted as the fight double for [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] during his [[lightsaber duel]]s in the ''The Empire Strikes Back'', as well as in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Star Wars Insider 132">{{InsiderCite|132|Launchpad}}</ref> Callum's full name was identified in his respective card in the [[2013]] digital card game ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]''.<ref name="FC" />
